concepts.description: A structural unit representing a self-contained component of the AUV system.
A physical or simulated platform that embodies the robotic capabilities of the AUV system.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate and exchange data or events.
A control component within the AUV system responsible for managing operations or behaviors.
A basic data type defined within the AUV system to represent fundamental values.
A structured data type defined within the AUV system that aggregates multiple named values.
A named data element contained within an Interface, holding typed sensor or state information.
A named signal or invocation defined within an Interface that triggers behavior in the AUV system.
An input argument passed to an Event within an Interface of the AUV system.
A named computational operation defined within the AUV system that takes inputs and returns a result.

instances.description: The top-level module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform contained within AUV_Module, using the Sensors and Actuators interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to access sensor data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to control actuator outputs.
A controller contained within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs interface to receive operator commands.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Operator to receive input commands.
A controller for the Last Response Engine, contained within AUV_Module, using the Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot to send output commands.
A controller contained within AUV_Module that uses the Outputs interface to issue autopilot commands.
A primitive type representing natural numbers, defined by AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing integer numbers, defined by AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing string values, defined by AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing boolean values, defined by AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing real numbers, defined by AUV_Module.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, recording radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A field of SVec representing the radial component of a spherical vector, of type real.
A field of SVec representing the polar component of a spherical vector, of type real.
A field of SVec representing the azimuth component of a spherical vector, of type real.
A composite type representing an obstacle, recording ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id, and obs_hdng values.
A field of Obstacle representing the north-south relative distance, of type real.
A field of Obstacle representing the east-west relative distance, of type real.
A field of Obstacle representing the depth of the obstacle, of type real.
A field of Obstacle representing the identifier of the obstacle, of type real.
A field of Obstacle representing the obstacle heading, of type SVec.
A value in the Sensors interface representing the heading of the AUV, of type SVec.
A value in the Sensors interface representing a detected obstacle, of type Obstacle.
An interface defined by AUV_Module (intended as Inputs) containing events for task and motion management.
An event in the Intpus interface signalling the end of a task, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting an Obstacle Collision Mode, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting a Manual Override Mode, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting a Heading Change Mode, with no parameters and no return value.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting the current velocity, with no parameters and a return value of type real.
An event in the Intpus interface requesting the current heading, with no parameters and a return value of type real.
An event in the Outputs interface that advises a velocity value, taking one parameter of type real with no return value.
An event in the Outputs interface that advises a heading value, taking one parameter of type real with no return value.
A composite type representing close approach data, recording horiz_cda, vert_cda, and id values.
A field of Close representing the horizontal closest distance of approach, of type real.
A field of Close representing the vertical closest distance of approach, of type real.
A function defined by AUV_Module that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the obstacle as real.
A function defined by AUV_Module that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the obstacle as real.
A function defined by AUV_Module that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the obstacle as real.
